name: simcluster-arcade
title: simcluster arcade
blurb: mortal kombat, but it's the simcluster, as an arcade cabinet: a versus screen, round/fight/k.o. announcer, eight fighter classes with their own specials and a live guava genome locus (after @abeliansoup.bsky.social). pick one of the simcluster regulars and climb the cast, or enter the pvp lobby to see who else is online and fight them peer-to-peer. asked for by @bisks.net.
